reasoning: The novel needs a long delayed-payoff arc in its first pages more than it needs immediate thematic explanation.
Zhou's v2 leaves more unanswered and allows readers to discover later that a virtue can become an organizational trap.
Luo's chapter becomes stronger as chapter 3 after the book has already shown both solitary technical life and ordinary peer life.
The sequence Zhou -> ordinary ensemble trip -> Luo creates three different registers early: private work, weak-tie life, institution-facing career friction.

ordinary world expansion; relationships remain weak and non-instrumental
